# Kaydyacha Ani Faydyacha (कायद्याचं आणि फायद्याचं)

> Digital educational publisher of Marathi-language ebooks on civic and legal literacy. Topics: RTI, consumer rights, business basics, inheritance, property rights, women's rights. For educational reference only — not legal advice or professional consultation.

## About
- **Legal Name**: Kaydyacha Ani Faydyacha
- **Proprietor**: Shrutika Gochade
- **Registration**: Udyam UDYAM-MH-26-1024122 (MSME)
- **Type**: Digital ebook publisher (PDF only)
- **Location**: Pune, Maharashtra, India
- **Languages**: Marathi (primary), Hindi, English
- **Website**: https://www.kaydyachaanifaydyach.com
